$comment: GET /v1.0/me/events with OData query options, response a collection of event. Read from the Graph v1.0 reference. A notification says THAT something changed and which id; this is how a host reads the rest, and how it resyncs after a missed lease.
title: Outlook calendar events
description: List events from the connected account's Outlook calendar.

config.label: Page size
config.description: Events per page. An @odata.nextLink in the response means there are more.

config.label: Filter
config.description: An OData $filter. Leave blank for everything.

config.label: Order
config.description: An OData $orderby. Leave blank for Graph's default order.

config.label: Fields
config.description: An OData $select, comma separated. Leave blank for Graph's default set.

outputShape.description: The events on this page, each shaped like event_get's output.
Present when there is another page: the full URL of the next one.
Which estate this ran against: fake, sandbox or live.
